u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.credit_score, u.credit_level, (SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id LIMIT 1) AS role_code, (SELECT r.role_name FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id LIMIT 1) AS role_name, u.store_id, s.store_name, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time,
/* 订单数不含已取消；消费额不含待支付与已取消（待支付是没到账的钱） */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'COMPLETED') AS finished_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('WAIT_PICKUP', 'IN_USE', 'WAIT_RETURN', 'OVERDUE')) AS active_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'WAIT_PAY')) AS total_spend
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = u.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.status = #{q.status}
AND u.credit_level = #{q.level}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = #{q.roleCode} )
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id DESC

SELECT
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = u.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(u.status = 1), 0) AS normal, COALESCE(SUM(u.status = 0), 0) AS frozen, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = ur.user_id AND cu.deleted = 0 WHERE r.role_code = 'USER') AS customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = ur.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE r.role_code = 'STORE_ADMIN') AS store_admins, COALESCE(SUM(u.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), 0) AS month_new FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND r.role_code = #{roleCode}
